Visit note | 2025-07-26 12:30 PM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Parvez Majumder, 41, male. Mr. Majumder returns for a review of his ongoing bowel symptoms. He reports that his stools continue to switch between loose and hard, accompanied by cramping belly pain that flares on long commutes through traffic in Sirajganj. He works as a fisherman. He reports no red flag symptoms such as rectal bleeding or unexpected weight loss. On examination: pain score 6/10, BP 110/76 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, weight 84 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild tenderness in the left lower quadrant. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued to help manage his symptoms. He was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-07-26 12:30 PM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Mahmuda Haque, 61, female. Mrs. Haque attends for her first visit complaining of frequent headaches, which she attributes to long hours at a screen, high stress, and neck tightness that has grown worse since long daily commutes in Banani. She works as an electrician. She denies visual disturbances, numbness, or weakness. On examination: pain score 3/10, BP 128/76 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 50 kg. Cranial nerves are intact and neck movements are slightly stiff without focal tenderness. Assessment: Tension-type headache. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to take screen breaks every hour, do regular neck stretches, and ensure seven hours of sleep nightly. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-07-26 12:30 PM | Dr. Shamima Nasrin, Ophthalmology | Patient: Mostafa Majumder, 65, male. Mr. Majumder presents for his first visit with sticky yellow discharge and eyelids stuck together in the morning. He notes that the issue started during an outbreak at an office in Kushtia. He works as a shopkeeper. He reports no severe eye pain or changes in vision. On examination: visual acuity 6/12 in the right eye, BP 135/81 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 44 kg. Conjunctivae are injected with mild purulent discharge bilaterally; corneas are clear. Assessment: Bacterial conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash his hands often, avoid sharing towels, and stay away from work for two days. Follow-up in 1 week if not better.

Visit note | 2025-07-26 03:00 PM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Bushra Karim, 46, female. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce intake of tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-07-26 03:30 PM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Obaidul Hasan, 54, male. He works as a police constable. He denies tremors or visual changes. On examination: pulse 126 bpm, BP 130/83 mmHg, weight 78 kg. Thyroid gland is diffusely enlarged and smooth; no exophthalmos is noted. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee, and to rest whenever his heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.

Visit note | 2025-07-26 03:30 PM | Dr. Mehedi Hasan, Ophthalmology | Patient: Fariha Uddin, 69, female. Visit note | 2025-07-26 04:30 PM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Tamim Patwary, 56, male. Mr. Patwary attends for a follow-up visit. He was advised to cut down on salt, pickles, and dried fish, walk 30 minutes daily, and check his blood pressure at home twice a week. Follow-up in 1 month with home blood pressure readings.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 10:00 AM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Emon Dewan, 46, male. Visit note | 2025-07-27 10:30 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Mehedi Pramanik, 41, male. Mr. Pramanik attends for a follow-up visit regarding his digestive symptoms. He works as a security guard. He denies difficulty swallowing or unexplained weight loss. On examination: BMI 30.1, BP 130/77 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, weight 59 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild epigastric tenderness. Assessment: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat smaller meals, avoid oily and spicy food late at night, and raise the head of his bed. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 11:00 AM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Kamal Talukder, 51, male. Mr. Talukder comes in for a follow-up visit reporting a long history of smoking and wheezing on walking, which worsened during the dusty dry season in Motijheel. He works as a rickshaw puller. He denies chest pain or ankle swelling. On examination: SpO2 89%, BP 113/77 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 78 kg. Chest auscultation reveals bilateral expiratory wheezes and reduced breath sounds. Follow-up in 1 week, sooner if breathing worsens.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 11:00 AM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Rahima Miah, 64, female. Mrs. Miah attends for a follow-up visit reporting stiffness in the morning for a few minutes and a creaking knee, symptoms that have grown worse since moving to a building with no lift in Sylhet. She works as a farmer and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She reports no joint instability or locking. On examination: BMI 33.2, BP 135/72 mmHg, pulse 68 bpm, weight 66 kg. Right knee shows mild crepitus on movement with a small effusion and restricted terminal flexion. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 11:30 AM | Dr. Mahbuba Rahman, Psychiatry | Patient: Tasnim Sikder, 19, female. Miss Sikder attends for a follow-up visit describing tense muscles, poor sleep, and feeling restless, which began after witnessing a road accident in Mymensingh. She appears anxious and tense during interview. Assessment: Generalized anxiety disorder. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to practise slow breathing daily, reduce tea and coffee intake, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 02:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Faruk Mollah, 26, male. Mr. Mollah comes in for a follow-up visit complaining of constant tiredness and looking pale, which he noticed after months of skipping lunch during long shifts in Gazipur. He works as a delivery rider. He denies gastrointestinal bleeding or shortness of breath on mild exertion. On examination: haemoglobin 8.4 g/dL, BP 113/86 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 60 kg. Conjunctivae are pale; cardiovascular examination is normal. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and to avoid drinking tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 02:00 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Fahim Talukder, 68, male. He works as a tailor. He denies fever or chest pain. On examination: SpO2 87%, BP 116/70 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, weight 73 kg. Chest examination shows diffuse wheezing and prolonged expiration. Assessment: COPD exacerbation. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to stop smoking completely, avoid cooking smoke, and take the yearly flu vaccine. Follow-up in 1 week, sooner if breathing worsens.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 02:00 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Bushra Mahmud, 50, female. Mrs. Mahmud comes in for a follow-up visit reporting being unable to reach behind her back, being unable to raise her arm, and having a stiff shoulder for weeks, which began after a minor fall at home in Rampura. She works as a beautician and has Bronchial asthma. She reports no localized neck pain or neurological deficits in the arm. On examination: shoulder lifts only to 65 degrees, BP 115/74 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 69 kg. Right shoulder range of motion is markedly restricted in all directions, especially rotation. Assessment: Adhesive capsulitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to start physiotherapy, perform pendulum exercises daily, and apply heat before exercise. Follow-up in 4 weeks with a physiotherapy review.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 02:00 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Nargis Gazi, 32, female. Mrs. Gazi attends for a follow-up visit reporting irregular periods, acne, and weight gain, which she noticed after a friend in Khilgaon suggested testing. She works as a delivery rider. She denies hot flushes, pelvic pain, or visual changes. On examination: BMI 30.0, BP 124/77 mmHg, pulse 73 bpm, weight 75 kg. Mild facial acne and hirsutism are observed; abdominal examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 02:30 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Habib Bepari, 44, male. Mr. Bepari presents for his first visit complaining of itchy raised welts that come and go, swelling of the lips at times, and symptoms that started after taking a new painkiller bought in Farmgate. He works as a beautician. He denies breathing difficulty or tongue swelling at present. On examination: about 23 welts on the trunk and arms, BP 128/72 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 63 kg. Skin shows erythematous wheezes with central clearing; lungs are clear. Assessment: Acute urticaria. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid the suspected food or medicine, keep a symptom diary, and go to hospital at once if the tongue or throat swells. Follow-up in 2 weeks with the symptom diary.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 03:00 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Tasnim Munshi, 45, female. Mrs. Munshi comes in for her first visit describing sudden attacks of a racing heart and a persistent fear of dying, with the first attack having happened at a busy market in Barishal. She works as a fisherman and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She denies chest pain radiating to the jaw or arm, and denies suicidal intent. On examination: about 12 panic attacks in the last month, BP 130/80 mmHg, pulse 79 bpm, weight 58 kg. She appears restless and hypervigilant. Assessment: Panic disorder. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to practise slow breathing during attacks, reduce caffeine intake, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 03:30 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Wasim Karim, 47, male. Mr. Karim attends for his first visit presenting with a sudden high fever, a faint rash on the arms, and severe aching in the bones and muscles, which started after a week of stagnant rainwater around the house in Lalbagh. He works as a bus driver and has Essential hypertension. He denies bleeding gums or black stools currently. On examination: platelet count 98000 per microlitre, temperature 101.3°F, BP 136/86 mmHg, pulse 94 bpm, weight 54 kg. Skin shows a faint blanching macular rash; abdomen is soft. Assessment: Dengue fever. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to drink at least three litres of fluid a day, avoid ibuprofen and aspirin, repeat the platelet count in 48 hours, and go to hospital at once for bleeding gums, black stools, or severe belly pain. Follow-up in 48 hours with a repeat platelet count.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 03:30 PM | Dr. Imran Kabir, Gastroenterology | Patient: Rashed Molla, 57, male. Mr. Molla presents for his first visit with loose watery stools, frequent vomiting, and cramping belly cramps, which began after a picnic in Badda. He works as a garment merchandiser. He reports no blood in the stool or high fever. On examination: pulse 116 bpm, BP 128/71 mmHg, weight 59 kg. Mucous membranes are slightly dry; abdomen is soft with mild diffuse tenderness. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat bland foods like rice, bananas, and toast, and wash his hands before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.

Visit note | 2025-07-27 03:30 PM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Sajjad Bhuiyan, 58, male. Visit note | 2025-07-27 03:30 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Tuhin Sheikh, 56, male.
